race.comment: It's hard to knock the form of the well-related PRECISE STAR (7) (half to G2 winner Mokulua) who has strung three wins together on the bounce this campaign and is racing with a lot of confidence. Gets 3kg off from the inside alley and can continue on his winning ways. RIEZ SOUVENT (10) wasn't too far away last time out and should get a cosy run in transit from gate two. Rock-hard fit and is expected to be very competitive against this line-up. ROCHEDALE HERO (11) got the job done at Ipswich at the latest effort and winning rider Maloney sticks in the stirrups. Can go back-to-back without surprising. DETRIMENTAL (1) was a dominant Beaudesert winner last start and is another to get some weight relief. In the mix on best figures.
